decision: Required to start the Sprint from the pit lane.
fact: The setup of the car has been changed while under Parc Ferme and the team continued to work on the car beyond the covers-on time.
offence: Breaches of Articles B3.4.2a and B3.5.7 of the FIA F1 Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the Sprint from the pit lane.
reason: Atlassian Williams F1 Team changed the setup of Car 23 under Parc Ferme, without the approval of the Technical Delegate. Furthermore, Atlassian Williams F1 Team continued to work on the car beyond the covers-on time which is a breach of article B3.4.2a of the FIA F1 Regulations. The F1 car is therefore required to start the Sprint from pit lane as per Article B3.5.3b of the FIA F1 Regulations.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 23 Parc Ferme
to: The Team Manager, Atlassian Williams F1 Team
